reasons: Cited text matches the preferred position: Section 28.1 selects New York law and Section 28.2 grants exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County with irrevocable submission and venue/forum waiver.

No arbitration clause is present, so there is no foreign seat concern; the injunctive-relief carve-out is mutual and customary, and the Section 28.3 escalation expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed, and the deterministic check confirms the jurisdiction is within the accepted set.
